text: The government claims that it wants to stabilize the economy and build buffers, after which it will move towards growth. However, foreign investment is not coming in for these buffers, and exports are also not seeing any significant increase. What is the reason for this?
translated_text: 政府声称希望稳定经济并建立缓冲，之后将转向增长。然而，外国投资并没有进入这些缓冲，出口也没有出现任何显着增长。这是什么原因呢？
